scope: Build a local notes API with persistent storage and documented verification; deployment is outside scope.

requirements.title: Create and retrieve notes
requirements.acceptance: A verified request can create a note and retrieve the same stored content by its stable identifier.

requirements.title: Reject invalid note content
requirements.acceptance: Empty or oversized content is rejected with a documented client error and no stored record.

plans.title: Implement the notes service
plans.outcome: Provide the storage and service behavior for valid and invalid notes.
plans.scope: Create only the named service and test files inside the generic API profile.
plans.architecture: A service owns validation and delegates persistence to a small repository boundary.

tasks.title: Implement and verify note creation and retrieval
steps: Implement a repository-backed note service with stable identifiers and explicit validation failures.
Exercise valid creation/retrieval and invalid empty/oversized content in the named test file.
acceptance: Valid content round-trips through the service.
Invalid content creates no stored record and returns a stable error.
verification: Run the project test command recorded in the governed workspace and capture its exit code.
failure_behavior: Leave the task incomplete with the failing assertion and next action when verification fails.

rules: Use only standard-library persistence for this example.
Do not put credentials or personal note contents in durable organizer records.
